sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A white lotus flower found blooming in the depths of the Sunken Valley, where the Fountainhead Waters pool deeply.
The flower's aroma attracts female apes. Thus the Guardian Ape carefully tended to it, so as to offer it to his bride.
One of the incense ingredients sought by the Divine Heir of the Immortal Severence.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Give to Kuro as one of the three ingredients needed to reach the Divine Realm.
